'''Mareesh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Senator/Legends|representative]] of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] in [[3653 BBY]], prior to the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] which ended the stalemated [[Great Galactic War]]. Under the punitive treaty, the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] annexed Rodia and several other Republic systems.

As the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] began their unopposed reign over [[the galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], Rodia was transferred to the Sith Empire. Due to the perceived betrayal of his homeworld, former senator Mareesh confronted the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Paran Am-Ris]] who tried to explain that the Republic had little choice since the the Empire would have destroyed [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] if the treaty was not signed. However, this did little to soothe Mareesh who stormed out of the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Tower]], refusing to hear anymore excuses and leaving Am Ris and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Zym]].
